What's New in v1.0.5

  • 📝 Description: New Layout History, update layouts from your current Dock, add multiple apps at once, more stable Dock editing, and big improvements to Focus Mode detection.
  • ✨ New: Layout History – Modoki now keeps recent Dock layout snapshots, so you can quickly restore a previous layout if needed. Even if it wasn't saved!
  • ✨ New: Update current layout from Dock – you can now refresh an existing layout using your current Dock setup instead of recreating it manually.
  • ✨ New: Add multiple apps at once – adding apps to layouts is now faster and more convenient.
  • 📈 Improvements: Improved Focus Mode detection and auto-revert reliability.
  • 📈 Improvements: Improved Dock scrolling behavior for larger layouts, making it easier to work with many apps.
  • 📈 Improvements: More reliable app adding – some apps previously could have issues with being added to layouts.
  • 🛠️ Fix: Fixed multiple bugs around applying, updating, and restoring layouts.
  • 🛠️ Fix: General cleanup and internal improvements for a smoother, more reliable experience.
